marta: Pushed a canary for magnet-70b int4v2 onboarding. Running long-context prefill tests and seeing a repeating 'echo' at the exact KV boundary (~16384 tokens).
lee: Can you paste the reproduce command?
marta: Sure — short script: 
```bash
# reproduce (local canary)
KV_CACHE=1 ./bin/run_infer --model magnet-70b-int4v2 --mode prefill --tokens 32000 --prompt-file tests/long_anchor.txt
```
ben: I ran that with KV_CACHE=0 and the echo disappears. So it smells like a KV index/offset bug, not raw attention.
kai: Did you try forcing rotary scale to the same value the compiler emits? We changed default rope_cap from 32768 -> 65536 for the new quant path last week. Could be a mismatch.
marta: I logged the runtime config and compiler metadata. Compiler writes "rope_scale: 0.998" but runtime prints "rope_scale: 1.002" for int4 runtime kernels. Small, but at 16k boundary it amplifies.
sophie: Any quality evals showing regression?
marta: Quick eval across a small goldset: perplexity jumps at the boundary (mean PPL pre-boundary 12.4 -> post-boundary 32.1). Also see token repetition in samples: 
```
...the cat sat on the mat mat mat mat...
```
lee: Oof. Can you run a minimal bisect to confirm whether the mismatch originates in compiler flags or NVPACK kernel selection? Something like run with kernel_override=fp16_kern vs int4kern.
marta: Yup did that: override to fp16 kernel removes the echo. So the int4 kernel path is doing something different when computing rotated indices.
ben: Could be index truncation or integer rounding for position multipliers. Any off-by-one in the k-v concat code?
kai: I'll add a small debug dump that prints KV indices + rotary phase for tokens [16370..16390] on both kernel versions and compare. If it's an index arithmetic bug we'll see drift.
infra-bot: deploybot: Deployed debug-canary to canary-03 with extra KV index logging. CID: d3b2f.
sophie: Meanwhile, let's schedule the evals: run the goldset on canary-03 and canary-02 (no debug) and capture token-level diffs. I can script a diff tool.
marta: Attaching quick diff snippet (abbreviated): 
```
--- canary-02 (fp16)
"...on the mat"
+++ canary-03 (int4v2)
"...on the mat mat mat"
```
lee: Action items: 1) kai to add KV index-phase dump and post logs. 2) ben to trace the int4 kernel: check fixed-point mul/shift behavior. 3) marta to run a focused eval set (50 long prompts) with/without KV cache. 4) sophie to run automated regression alerts on the goldset.
kai: Started a reproducer that writes CSV: token_index, kv_index, rope_phase_compiler, rope_phase_runtime. Pushing to PR now.
marta: PR tested; logs show kv_index drift starts at token 16384 and accumulates +1 every 128 tokens in the int4 path. That explains repeated tokens.
ben: Nice find. That pattern screams integer overflow in the index stride calculation (maybe 16-bit somewhere).
sophie: I'll pause the canary rollout until we have a fix. Marking the model as "blocked" in onboarding dashboard.
lee: For an immediate mitigation, can we enable a runtime patch that clamps per-layer index arithmetic to 64-bit or forces fallback to fp16 kernel for sequences > 16k?
kai: Quick patch to cast to int64 on the stride calc reduces drift in my local run. I'll open a hotfix PR and run full tests.
marta: I'll re-run the 50-prompt eval after kai's patch. If green, we can un-block.
infra-bot: ci-bot: CI passed for debug branch (unit tests + smoke longprefill): green.
sophie: Thanks team — great triage. Let's also add a long-tail integration test that runs on every int4 kernel change to catch this early.
marta: Agreed. Created ticket RW-12567 for long-tail regression test + add to pre-merge.
lee: Thanks, closing loop once hotfix is in staging. :thumbsup:
